title: hedyosmum domingense subsp. cubense
intro: Hedyosmum domingense subsp. cubense, commonly known as Cuban waxflower, is a plant species that belongs to the family Staphydiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds and flu, reduce fever, and soothe wounds. The therapeutic actions of Hedyosmum domingense subsp. cubense include its ability to act as an expectorant, reducing mucus production and facilitating cough relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
